article.hook: Someone just made a scene for affection, and it wasn’t awkward. Venus in Leo asks: how bright can your heart beam before it feels right? This is love that demands applause, not whispers.
article.lived: Over the next four weeks, we say “I like you” by turning up the volume - whether it’s the playlist, the laugh, or the way we light the room just by entering it. We hold attention with an easy smile and throw compliments like confetti. When you dress, decorate, or text, you don’t hide what you feel; you broadcast it, proud and unfiltered, as if waiting for someone to catch the sparkle.
article.turn: The spotlight can burn if you expect every glance to be a standing ovation. When love feels like a performance, we start measuring worth by who’s looking and how loud the cheers are. You can’t proofread affection like a script - crave applause, and you may hear only an empty room.
moves: Wear one bold color or accessory that makes you glow in every mirror you pass.
Name one thing you admire out loud to someone who doesn’t expect it.
Plan a moment to celebrate a small win with friends or yourself, loud enough to be remembered.
